name: Blades
description: Knives, swords, and anything you can stab with that wasn't designed for salad.

perks.name: Decapitation
perks.text: Every blade hit has a 5% chance to take a non-boss's head clean off.

perks.name: Quick Edge
perks.text: Blade crits land on a natural 18-20.

perks.name: Surgeon
perks.text: +2 damage with blades.

name: Blunt Weapons
description: Hammers, clubs, maces. The honest way to solve problems.

perks.name: Lights Out
perks.text: Every blunt hit has a 5% chance to knock a non-boss out cold. Counts as a kill.

perks.name: Heavy Hands
perks.text: +2 damage with blunt weapons.

perks.name: Can Opener
perks.text: Blunt hits ignore 3 points of armor.

name: Polearms
description: Long sticks with bad intentions on the end.

perks.name: Reach
perks.text: A polearm swings at near range, up to 3 tiles away. Let them come to you. They won't get there.

perks.name: Keep Back
perks.text: +2 guard while you're holding a polearm.

perks.name: Skewer
perks.text: +2 damage with polearms.

name: Bows
description: Pointy sticks, delivered at a respectful distance.

perks.name: Pinned
perks.text: A great bow hit (tier 3) slows the target for a round.

perks.name: Dead Eye
perks.text: Bow crits land on a natural 18-20.

perks.name: Broadheads
perks.text: +2 damage with bows.

name: Thrown Weapons
description: Darts, knives, bricks, and the occasional sandwich.

perks.name: Bullseye
perks.text: A crit with a thrown weapon stuns the target for a round.

perks.name: Fastball
perks.text: +2 damage with thrown weapons.

perks.name: Trick Shot
perks.text: Thrown-weapon crits land on a natural 18-20.

name: Unarmed Combat
description: Fists, elbows, knees, and teeth if it comes to that.

perks.name: Knuckles
perks.text: Your fists hit 2/4/6.

perks.name: Iron Fists
perks.text: Your fists hit 3/5/7.

perks.name: Haymaker
perks.text: A great unarmed hit (tier 3) stuns the target for a round.

name: Improvised Weapons
description: Plungers, kettlebells, a microwave you found. If it's in your hand, it's a weapon.

perks.name: Anything Goes
perks.text: +2 to the roll with improvised weapons.

perks.name: Wrong Tool, Right Job
perks.text: Great improvised hits (tier 3) do 50% more damage.

perks.name: Junk Savant
perks.text: Improvised-weapon crits land on a natural 18-20.

name: Light Armor
description: Leather, padding, and hope.

perks.name: Light on Your Feet
perks.text: +1 defense in light armor.

name: Heavy Armor
description: Wearing a car door and calling it fashion.

perks.name: Thick Skin
perks.text: Reduce all physical damage by 1.

name: Shields
description: Holding a big thing between you and the bad thing.

perks.name: Wall
perks.text: +1 defense with a shield.

name: Dodge
description: The ancient art of not being where the axe is.

perks.name: Slippery
perks.text: +1 defense.

perks.name: Exit Strategy
perks.text: +2 to flee.

name: Stealth
description: Being quiet. Being small. Being somewhere else.

perks.name: Ambush
perks.text: First attack from stealth always crits.

name: Perception
description: Noticing the trap before the trap notices you.

perks.name: Trap Sense
perks.text: Always see trap rooms on the map once adjacent.

name: Lockpicking
description: Opening things that other people closed for a reason.

name: Trap Engineering
description: Understanding, disarming, and occasionally building nasty little machines.

name: First Aid
description: Bandages, pressure, and saying 'you'll be fine' convincingly.

perks.name: Field Medic
perks.text: Healing items restore 25% more.

name: Cooking
description: Turning dungeon meat into dungeon cuisine.

perks.name: Leftovers
perks.text: Cooked food lasts 2 extra rooms.

name: Explosives Handling
description: Throwing things that go boom, ideally away from your face.

perks.name: Steady Hands
perks.text: Explosives never fumble on a natural 1.

name: Athletics
description: Climbing, swimming, shoving doors, carrying a dead friend.

name: Appraisal
description: Knowing what something is and roughly what it's worth to a desperate person.

name: Fire Magic
description: Setting things on fire on purpose, at range, with your mind. Arson with extra steps.

perks.name: Accelerant
perks.text: Burning from your fire spells lasts 1 round longer.

perks.name: Third-Degree
perks.text: +2 damage with fire spells.

perks.name: Flashover
perks.text: Fire spells crit on 18-20.

name: Frost Magic
description: Making things colder than they want to be. Mostly their blood.

perks.name: Brain Freeze
perks.text: Your frost spells' slow lands on every solid hit (tier 2), not just great ones.

perks.name: Frostbite
perks.text: +2 damage with frost spells.

perks.name: Flash Freeze
perks.text: A great frost hit (tier 3) stuns the target for a round.

name: Lightning Magic
description: Being the thing the safety manual warned you about.

perks.name: Ground Fault
perks.text: Lightning spells arc to one more enemy nearby, for half the damage.

perks.name: Overcurrent
perks.text: Lightning spells crit on 18-20.

perks.name: High Voltage
perks.text: +2 damage with lightning spells.

name: Necromancy
description: Borrowing from the dead and the nearly dead. Mostly the nearly.

perks.name: Compound Interest
perks.text: Necrotic spells heal you for 25% more of the damage they do.

perks.name: Hemorrhage
perks.text: A great necrotic hit (tier 3) leaves the target bleeding for 3 rounds.

perks.name: Bone Deep
perks.text: Necrotic spells ignore 3 armor.

name: Light Magic
description: Shining things at people until they feel better or go blind. Sometimes both.

perks.name: Bedside Manner
perks.text: Light heals do 25% more.

perks.name: Retina Burn
perks.text: Your light spells' blinding lands on every solid hit (tier 2), not just great ones.

perks.name: Halogen
perks.text: +3 damage with light spells.

name: Protection Magic
description: Standing behind something invisible and hoping. It's more than most people get.

perks.name: Extended Warranty
perks.text: Your protection spells last 1 round longer.

perks.name: Bulk Discount
perks.text: Protection spells cost 1 less MP (minimum 1).

perks.name: Express Lane
perks.text: Protection spells come back 1 round sooner.

name: Illusion
description: Lying, with lights. The audience loves it when it works, and loves it more when it doesn't.

perks.name: Method Acting
perks.text: What your illusion spells inflict lasts 1 round longer.

perks.name: Cheap Tricks
perks.text: Illusion spells cost 1 less MP (minimum 1).

perks.name: Mass Hysteria
perks.text: Illusion spells cover a wider area: one target becomes a plus of five tiles.

name: Transmutation
description: Changing what things are made of, or at least how fast they're going.

perks.name: Slow Release
perks.text: What your transmutation spells do lasts 1 round longer.

perks.name: Quick Change
perks.text: Transmutation spells come back 1 round sooner.

perks.name: Group Rate
perks.text: Transmutation spells cover a wider area: one target becomes a plus of five tiles.

name: Utility Magic
description: The spells nobody films. They'd be keeping you alive, if anybody noticed.

perks.name: Efficient
perks.text: Utility spells cost 1 less MP (minimum 1).

perks.name: Long Battery
perks.text: Bad Feeling and other utility effects last 3 more rooms.

perks.name: Wide Net
perks.text: Sensing spells reach 2 more rooms.

name: Persuasion
description: Getting people to do things with words instead of hammers.

name: Intimidation
description: Getting people to do things with words that imply hammers.

name: Deception
description: Lying. Just lying. Very well.

name: Bartering
description: Paying less than the sticker price in a store run by a demon.

perks.name: Haggler
perks.text: Shop prices are 10% lower.

name: Tinkering
description: Making useful things out of useless things. Rank adds to crafting checks at a workbench.

perks.name: Tinkerer
perks.text: Your crafting checks get +2.
